messages:
kevin: pulling mage-70b-int8 onto staging, default max_new_tokens=1024, batch=8. hitting OOMs around step ~120, GPU 0. any quick ideas?
priya: saw similar with int8 quant on earlier bring-ups. fragmentation gets worse after a few requests. could try jemalloc or lower max_new_tokens / batch. :thinking: 
sasha: can you paste the exact error and the serve command you used?
kevin: paste log:
```
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 1.2 GiB (GPU 0; 40.0 GiB total; 35.6 GiB already allocated; 512.00 MiB free; 1.4 GiB cached)
  at /workspace/runtime/inference.cpp:432 in allocate_kernel
  kv_cache_alloc failed after 118 iterations
```
kevin: repro: `python serve.py --model mage-70b --quant int8 --batch 8 --max-new-tokens 1024 --kernel=auto`
matt: quick mitigation: drop `max_new_tokens` default for mage-70b-int8 to 512 for hosted traffic and set per-model `max_batch_size: 4` in model config. that avoids the late-stage OOMs we saw on other 70b int runs.
priya: also try env tweaks: `LD_PRELOAD=/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libjemalloc.so` and `MALLOC_CONF=oversize_threshold:1,background_thread:true` helped reduce fragmentation on our perf node. for runtime flags, `--kv-evict-threshold=0.65` + `--use-kv-prefetch=false` reduced memory churn.
kevin: tested batch=4 + max_new_tokens=512, run stayed up, throughput ~ -35% but no OOM. latency p95 increased though. eval-bot: perf-run 1769172400: p50 86ms, p95 320ms, tokens/sec 450.
priya: did you run quant-quality evals? int8 sometimes regresses on long-context summaries when kv caching is tightened.
kevin: quick eval on our long-summ set: ROUGE-L dropped 0.8 pts on avg vs fp16. shorter prompts are fine. suggests quantization + smaller kv retention is hurting context modeling.
sasha: ok lets do a canary: route 10% to mage-70b-int8 with batch_size 4 and max_new_tokens 512. if eval_regression > 0.5 ROUGE-L or OOMs > 0 -> automatic fallback to mage-70b-fp16. matt can you add rollout policy?
matt: will add canary + automatic fallback in rollout-config (A/B style). rule: if 3 OOMs in 5m or eval_delta.ROUGE-L < -0.5 -> fallback. also add experiment to test jemalloc + kernel bump on staging nodes.
priya: filed infra ticket: https://redwood/infra/issues/4623 - kernel bump + jemalloc test matrix for mage-70b-int8. tagging @kevin for memory profiler artifacts. :thumbsup:
kevin: thanks — I'll attach `nv-prof` dumps and `mallctl` stats tomorrow. planning to also try int4-per-channel on weights to see if we can regain quality without huge memory. :eyes:
eval-bot: scheduled eval 1769172425: quality-run complete. long-sum ROUGE-L: fp16=37.2, int8=36.4, int8+jemalloc=36.9. logging to /evaluations/mage70b/2026-02-10.json
kevin: useful numbers. next steps: canary rollout, enable jemalloc on staging, tune kv_evict_threshold, and consider lowering hosted default max_new_tokens for mage-70b-int8. will follow up with profiler outputs.
